title: Shiraishi An — Hop In!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Outside Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We got back pretty late again.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, that event did drag on a bit.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It did... I'm usually at home in bed by now. I might actually fall asleep sat on the train ride over.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, don't do that!
Who knows where you'll end up if you do!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, good point...
Then, I'll stand up so that doesn't happen!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Listening to some music should also help keep me awake.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I sure hope so... Seriously, don't let your guard down!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks for showing so much concern, An. Anyway, I'll see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh... S-Sorry.
Hehe. My stomach's really starting to growl...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. We did expend a ton of calories today!
Hm? So it is you, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh! An, it's your mom!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Welcome back, Mom!

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Are you two just coming back from practice?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! Actually, we just got back from doing an event. I was just seeing Kohane out.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Then, Kohane, would you like to have dinner with us?

rows.Speaker: An & Kohane
rows.Line:
What?!
Huh?

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, but... Your parents probably have dinner ready and are waiting for you...

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Still, you seem very tired, so I just thought you might like to come over for dinner and get some rest.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Would that really be okay?

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line:
Of course.
Incidentally, I bought a few too many things at the deli counter.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Is that why your hands are so full...?

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Because you've had a huge appetite lately, An. So, Kohane, I'd appreciate your help eating these.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-I'm not sure how much I can do to help, but I'll do my best!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You don't need to force yourself, you know?
We can just eat any leftovers tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. I appreciate the sentiment though. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Well then, I'm going to go call my mom to let her know!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! See you soon!
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, this is great! Dinner with Kohane! Thanks for offering, Mom!

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.
Several minutes later

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you for waiting.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
My mom said it's okay.
So, if you don't mind having me over...

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line:
Of course.
Please eat as much as you like, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you, I will!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Awesome!
Get ready for a feast, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, Mom, I'll carry some of that for you! I can take it over to the kitchen!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I'll help too.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, are you sure?
Then, I happily accept. Thank you both very much.

rows.Speaker: An & Kohane
rows.Line:
No problem!
Of course!

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Also, An was right. You really are a nice girl, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: An's always saying, “She's the best friend and partner anyone could ask for!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: M-Mom...!

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: She's told me so, so much about you, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, quit telling her things that she doesn't need to hear!

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Okay, I'll stop.

rows.Speaker: An's Mother
rows.Line: Anyway, let's go inside.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! Thank you again for having me!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Kohane looked exhausted a second ago, but she seems all better now.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (This might be the break she was looking for. I'll need to thank Mom later for doing this.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Come on in, Kohane!
